title: ID0413410-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001687] Failsafe Mode With Unknown Cause
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Failsafe mode with unknown cause due to swupdate 1/FAILURE
Solution: SSH commands

additional_info.subject: URGENT: SiD: MP / R4 170001687 rcIn0k: Failsafe mode with unknown cause
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Sicharge D
MP / R4 170001687
rcIn0k
FW V7.0.5
Issue date: 20th Aug 2025.
Issue description: Charger boots up and goes into fail safe mode.
Upon check XF3 is on Mobile sim card and pingable, XF4 is offline.
All SECC devices are online
We did a shutdown and boot up at UTC 2025-08-20T08:29:37.94
Preliminary seems to be a FW update corruption or missing file.
FW Update is via USB and the same USBs are used for 4 other chargers (working fine), so we ruled out USB issue.
Please HELP!
Edna Seah
